lines.text: Many learners say: I did a mistake.
We make a mistake, not do.

data.why: We make a mistake, not do.

native.hook: mistake は do じゃなくて make
native.tip: 「間違える」は make a mistake。do は使いません。セットで覚えよう。
native.caption: “I did a mistake.”と言っていませんか？😅 「間違いをする」を do で訳したくなりますが、英語では make a mistake がセットの言い方です。 “I made a mistake.” が自然な言い方です。Amaの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“made”。make a mistake で一つの表現。無料クイズで練習：{link}

en.hook: Is it “do” a mistake? Not really!
en.tip: Say make a mistake. Learn the two words together.
en.caption: Do you say “I did a mistake.”? 😅 You might translate suru as do, but English says make a mistake as a set phrase. The natural way is “I made a mistake.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
